description.text:
The eighth POP Series set, 17 cards Pokémon Organized Play gave out in packs at its leagues and tournaments from September 2008 to March 2009.

Every card in the packs is non-holo. Holo copies came later in shop products: Lucario in a reissued Lucario Collector's Tin (late 2008) and a Collector's Poster Box (November 2008), Heatran in Platinum blisters (February 2009), Yanmega in Collector's Poster Box 2 (March 2009), Luxray and Probopass in a Double Value Pack (April 2009), and Happiny in Arceus blisters (November 2009). Six came as cracked ice reverse holos: Cherrim and Carnivine in blisters that held one with a set's booster and a POP Series pack, Luxio in a Toys "R" Us box set, Chimchar and Riolu in the Trainer's Challenge Box (October 2009), and Croagunk in a bundle not yet identified.
